n = int(input())
base = int(input())

MOD = 1000000007
LIM = (1 << 63) - 1 - MOD * MOD

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, s):
        self.size = s
        self.mat = [[0] * (s + 1) for _ in range(s + 1)]
    def set_identity(self):
        for i in range(self.size + 1):
            for j in range(self.size + 1):
                self.mat[i][j] = 1 if i == j else 0

def gcd(a, b):
    while b:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

def multiply(A, B, C):
    s = A.size
    for i in range(s + 1):
        for j in range(s + 1):
            sum_ = 0
            for k in range(s + 1):
                if sum_ > LIM:
                    sum_ %= MOD
                sum_ += A.mat[i][k] * B.mat[k][j]
            C.mat[i][j] = sum_ % MOD

size = base
# Initialize 4D list: mat[61][size][size][size+1]
mat = [[[[Matrix(size) for _ in range(size)] for _ in range(size)] for _ in range(61)]]

for i in range(size):
    for j in range(size):
        for k in range(size + 1):
            for l in range(size + 1):
                mat[0][i][j][k].mat[k][l] = 1 if (k == l or j == l) else 0

ci = 0
step = 1
while step <= n // size:
    ci += 1
    step *= size

for i in range(1, ci + 1):
    for j in range(size):
        for k in range(size):
            mat[i][j][j][k].set_identity()
            for k2 in range(size):
                tmp = Matrix(size)
                multiply(mat[i][j][k2], mat[i - 1][(j + k2) % size][k2], tmp)
                mat[i][j][k] = tmp

have = Matrix(size)
have.set_identity()

cj = 0
step = 1
for _ in range(ci, -1, -1):
    times = (n // step) % size
    for _ in range(times):
        tmp = Matrix(size)
        multiply(have, mat[ci][cj][0], tmp)
        have = tmp
        cj += 1
        if cj >= size:
            cj -= size
    step //= size

result = 0
for k in range(size + 1):
    result += have.mat[k][size]
    if result >= MOD:
        result -= MOD

print(result)
